summary: Account-linking policy for existing users signing in through Google is unspecified.

title: Account-linking policy for Google sign-in
context: Existing users signing in through Google need a linking policy before the callback flow is finished.

options.label: Match by email
options.description: Link a Google identity to an existing account when the verified Google email matches.

tradeoffs.consequence: Lower friction: users are linked automatically without extra steps.
Trusts Google email verification; weaker against takeover of the Google account.

options.label: Require explicit linking
options.description: Ask the user to sign in with email/password first, then link the Google identity explicitly.

tradeoffs.consequence: Stronger verification: the password proves ownership of the existing account.
More user steps; linking requires an extra sign-in.
